{{Quote|I'm Whitat. This is my town. And those are my guns you're returning, from my men you killed.|Whitat|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Whitat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] and ran the small settlement of [[Moraine Outpost]]. After [[Danla Zin]]'s husband [[Magar (Human)|Magar]] was killed by [[Voidhound]] and [[Corso Riggs]] in a tragic misunderstanding, Whitat tried to take Zin's recovered shipment of weapons in her moment of weakness. With support from Riggs, Zin turned her blaster on him and kicked him out of the outpost.
